name: TRUSCA Self-Hosted SCA Portal
free_limit: Apache-2.0 self-hosted software for SBOM, CVE and license compliance management; no per-seat software license fee or published usage expiry. Deploy with Docker Compose or Helm.
watch_out: Self-hosted software only; provide your own compute, PostgreSQL, Redis, storage, HTTPS, backups and security maintenance. Vulnerability database updates and third-party scanner dependencies require network/resources; no free managed hosting is included.
